note: The week 2 result video, for the Bitcoin and Nasdaq Composite calls of 9-13 November 2026. `result` holds each market's two prices: Bitcoin's Coinbase open at 00:00 UTC Monday and its close at 23:59:59 UTC Friday; the Nasdaq Composite's official closes on Friday 6 and Friday 13 November. Each HIT and MISS, the scores, the percentages and the tally come from `result` and the calls, and his voice lines are checked against them, so a different price stops the build until the lines are rewritten. Frame 0 is the thumbnail: how many AIs got both, both moves, and the four logos stamped with their scores, both calls as triangles under each name. Then the Bitcoin calls under the logos; Friday's close: the week's 4h candles sweep in and the camera punches in on the figures. Then the Nasdaq calls, and its close the same way, from the daily candles. Then one card at a time, both calls stamped HIT or MISS and a jab under it; then the hero's own words are marked, and the tally against a coin. No disclaimer in the frame: it goes in the post text (CLAUDE.md rule 4). result-duo-story.js plays it; each card beat's `stamps` and `jab.at` count from its start, the verdict beat's `said` and the scored beat's `reveal` (when "A coin averages" and "One week proves nothing." start in his take) from their own. The timeline is the first cut's, 1.1 times faster, to match the takes in episode/out/voice/result-duo-2026-11-14-fast (atempo 1.1).
